name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Belgrade, she initially pursued a degree in fine arts, specializing in automotive design. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team led her to discover her true passion: the artistry and precision of paintwork on racing cars. She quickly learned the technical skills required, mastering the application of complex liveries and protective coatings. 

Milena joined Joe Gibbs Racing after several successful years with smaller European teams. She brings a meticulous approach to her work, always striving for perfection in every detail. Known for her ability to create visually stunning designs that also enhance aerodynamic performance, she is a valuable asset to the team. Her ambition drives her to constantly seek new techniques and materials to improve the quality and durability of the paint finishes.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Milena is of average height with a focused expression, always observing details.

quirks: Always has a small sketchbook on hand for impromptu design ideas.
Obsessively cleans her spray guns after each use.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
